regions.region: page 7 Scheme 3a control experiments a-1 through a-4
regions.finding: The original image confirms four distinct controls: omission of 4CzIPN, omission of Cu(acac)2, 6v regioselectivity/failure of expected 5va, and 6w Z/E outcome. Existing records were updated with direct page-image evidence rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 7 Scheme 3b prior oxysulfonylation conditions applied to 6b
regions.finding: A current-paper control under cited Ir/TsOH/DCM conditions gives product-specific NMR yields for 5ba and 4ba; this remains distinct from literature-only discussion and from the standard Cu/4CzIPN reaction.
The 1,1-diphenylethylene and TEMPO experiments are separate records with their own trap equivalents, substrate recoveries, product yields/non-detections, and the HRMS observation of 14ab.

regions.region: page 7 Scheme 3d reaction of optically active (R)-6s
regions.finding: The page image confirms 94% ee starting material, 17 h, 77% product, and 0% product ee; the existing record was enriched rather than duplicated.
A current-paper cyclic-voltammetry record captures Cu(acac)2 and 2a reduction potentials and the absence of a 6b reduction peak; missing instrumental details remain explicit.
The three displayed fitted lines for 6b, 2a, and Cu(acac)2 are recorded separately and support preferential quenching by Cu(acac)2.
The qualitative time-course was retained as evidence that yield increases with illumination and plateaus when light is off. Approximate graph-point values were not promoted to exact numeric yields.

unresolved: Scheme 3 omits workups/purifications and several measurement bases.
Cyclic-voltammetry, Stern–Volmer, and light on–off panels omit substantial instrument/reaction details.

regions.finding: The full photo/copper catalytic cycle is classified as a mechanism. Sulfonyl-radical, allyl-radical, and allyl-Cu intermediates are proposed and are not treated as isolated reactions.

regions.region: page 8 center Figure 1 DFT stability comparison
regions.finding: The four computed Cu intermediates, relative free energies, calculation level, and displayed geometric parameters are retained in a mechanism/computational record, not as experimental preparations.

The text supplies the numerical redox potentials, absence of a 6b peak, relative quenching conclusion, and light-dependence interpretation, which were merged into the three page-7 mechanistic-study records.

Figure 1 is computational support and does not establish experimental isolation.
Instrument settings and exact light-cycling protocol remain incomplete.

regions.region: page 9 upper-left continuation of Scheme 4 and Figure 1 discussion

The conclusion summarizes scope and mechanistic evidence already represented; it adds no independent reaction arrow, condition row, or yield.
